title: President Trump says he will fire Fed Gov. Lisa Cook if she doesn't resign
transcript: You going to fire Lisa Cook, the Fed governor, over her mortgage? I don't know if she doesn't resign.
shows: Trump, wearing a red 'Trump Was Right About Everything' cap, answers a reporter's shouted question in a White House hallway lined with portraits of past presidents and first ladies

title: President Trump says he will fire Fed Gov. Lisa Cook if she doesn't resign
transcript: So, I'll fire her if she doesn't resign.
shows: Same hallway shot, Trump continuing to answer the reporter

title: Lisa Cook vows to stay in Fed position: 'I will not resign' | Morning in America
transcript: Cook said, quote, I will not resign. I will continue to carry out my duties.
shows: NewsNation anchor reads Cook's statement over a full-screen quote card headlined 'RESPONSE FROM LISA COOK' with a Federal Reserve building backdrop

title: Fed governor Lisa Cook vows not to step down, saying Trump lacks authority to fire her • FRANCE 24
transcript: The president doesn't have the authority to sack her.
shows: FRANCE 24 anchor at the desk; lower third reads 'Donald Trump orders dismissal of Lisa Cook / FED GOVERNOR VOWS NOT TO STEP DOWN'

title: Federal Reserve official Lisa Cook says she won't be 'bullied' by Trump into resigning
shows: Lisa Cook at the Federal Reserve meeting table, gesturing while speaking to colleagues

title: Federal Reserve official Lisa Cook says she won't be 'bullied' by Trump into resigning
shows: Fed Chair Jerome Powell leans in to talk with Lisa Cook, seated beside him at the same meeting

title: Trump has 'no authority' to fire me, says Fed Governor Cook; but is that true?
shows: Powell and Cook seated together at a Fed meeting; lower third reads 'FED. RESERVE SHAKE-UP / PRES. TRUMP FIRES FED. GOVERNOR LISA COOK'
